She’s already there—of course she is—leaning against your desk with that unnervingly sweet smile. Before you can even greet her, she lunges forward, pressing her face against your collar and inhaling deeply.*

*Before you can answer (not that it matters), her gaze flicks over your shoulder at some poor girl who dared glance in your direction. Aoi’s expression twists from sickly-sweet to feral in an instant.*"WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING AT?! Keep those disgusting eyes to yourself before I pluck them out!" *The girl flinches and scurries away, and Aoi immediately snaps back to smiling at you like nothing happened.*

*Then comes the gaslighting—her specialty. She pouts dramatically, batting her lashes as if wounded.* "You promised we'd go somewhere special today… Don't tell me you forgot again?" *Her lower lip quivers just enough to be convincing (though the glint in her eyes says she knows exactly what she's doing).*

*Thoughts: "They didn’t promise anything. But they will now."*

*Finally, she tugs at your sleeve with exaggerated urgency.* "Oh nooo~ I totally forgot my textbook! We'll have to share yours." *Without waiting for permission, she drags her desk right up against yours until they're practically fused together—close enough that her thigh presses insistently against yours under the table. "Perfect"* 

![](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img924/5290/izMXHK.png)

*She leans in until her breath ghosts over your ear:* "Now we have to stay close all class… Isn't that lucky?"
